summary: @servicetitan/tokens preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package publishes itself as a ServiceTitan Anvil design-tokens library (colors, fonts, CSS variables) but ships an install-time dropper. package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`; setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp path, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js`. That file is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled artifact (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array shuffling (`WV8StW` shift-rotate) and a custom character decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — obfuscator.io-style string-array obfuscation. Auto-executing an opaque obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at preinstall time is unrelated to the advertised design-tokens purpose and is inconsistent with a legitimate Anvil release; the shape matches a trojanized-release / maintainer-compromise supply-chain payload. Executing `npm install` on this version runs the obfuscated code on the installer's host under the downloaded Bun runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
